notes:
Lead: ex-PaaS engineering team building an in-app assistant for B2B customer portals. Very latency-focused — wants streaming responses so users see tokens as they arrive. Self-serve sign-up; likely to stay on hosted if latency and cost look good. Wants to avoid VPC/on-prem complexity for now.

Shorthand from calls: - 'need type-ahead feel, sub-200ms p95 ideally' - 'we're billing by seat; token overages = big blocker' - 'prefer client websocket + server-sent events fallback'

Security: SOC2 required by some target customers; they already use Okta and asked about SSO/SAML and audit logs. Cares about data retention policy (30-90d) and ability to purge test data.

Docs/links provided: pricing deck, quickstart for streaming, sample SDK snippet. Developers comfortable with JS/websocket; backend in Node.
use_case_summary: Early-stage B2B SaaS: in-app chat assistant embedded in customer-facing web app. Primary workload = low-latency streaming chat (token-by-token) for short exchanges (20-60 tokens typical). Secondary: message summarization of conversations for tickets. Target is p95 think-time <200ms for first tokens, sustained throughput ~50-200 concurrent users during demo phase. Cost sensitive — prefers per-token hosted pricing; interested in caching/batching recommendations if it doesn't hurt latency. Prefers hosted_api to avoid infra ops; will evaluate Dedicated only if hosted cannot meet latency SLOs.
